title: Cognis Ghost Text Stems
description: Versioned configuration of on-device ghost-text stem templates, one list per gap type (Engineering Contracts: Yogesh owns Ghost Text). Loaded at runtime so wording is tuned without a code change. Stems are gentle openers the user continues, never full completions.

note.description: Optional human note about provenance / disclosure.

pauseThresholdMs.description: Minimum pause duration (ms) that triggers a ghost-text offer — the cognitive-pause window.

gapRecencyMs.description: How recently (ms) a gap must have been detected for a pause to surface a stem for it.

maxStemLength.description: Maximum allowed stem length (characters). Stems must stay short and non-intrusive.

stems.description: Stem templates keyed by gap type. Every gap type must have at least one stem.

stemList.description: Ordered list of stem templates for a gap type.
